in_sanskrit.name: सौम्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit word ‘सौम्य’ (sau-mya), meaning ‘kind’, ‘gentle’, ‘soothing’, ‘calming’, ‘serene’. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘सौम्’ (saum), which means ‘calm’, ‘tranquil’, ‘soothing’, ‘soothing to the senses’. The prefix ‘सौ’ (sau) in the name adds the meaning of ‘kindness’ or ‘goodness’ to the name.

in_hindi.name: सौम्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name ‘सौम्या’ (Saumya) is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘सौम्य’ (saumya), which means ‘kind’, ‘gentle’, ‘soothing’, ‘calming’, ‘serene’. In Hindi, the word ‘साँझेदार’ (saanjedar) is used to describe a person who is kind, compassionate, and gentle. This name is therefore often given to girls who are believed to possess these qualities.

The Tamil word ‘கிழம்போட்டம்’ (kilambottam) is used to describe a person who is kind, compassionate, and gentle, which is a fitting meaning for this beautiful name.

This word is used to describe the peaceful, calm, and soothing qualities of the divine beings, such as the gods and goddesses. The name is therefore considered to be of great spiritual significance and is often given to children as a mark of respect for the divine.
